verdict.rationale: Approved after two revision rounds: dropped phantom node-pty dependency, split fixture capture into 3 recordings, fixed message-extraction/anchor-matching bugs, added real answered-prompt-not-redetected test with its own fixture.

Reject CR-001/CR-002 (defensive guards on a pure single-caller internal function — unnecessary per project style). Narrow CR-004's fix instead of the reviewer's version (only skip a line if the WHOLE trimmed line is a parenthesized hint, not any line starting with '('). Modify CR-003's fix to strip only literal hint text ((Use arrow keys), y/n confirm hints) and never a parenthesized default value, since real fixtures encode defaults there (modelManual, profileName, codemieUrl) that a downstream ticket needs. Accept CR-005/CR-006/CR-007 as recommended. Additionally: user found an unreported defect — credential catch-all misclassifies a partial-render mid-word line (provider-answered-then-next-open.json) as a complete credential prompt; must require the open line to end with ':', a parenthesized default, or a hint before falling to credential, else return null.

Fix-up applied per owner's adjusted instructions: CR-001/002 rejected, CR-003/004 narrowed, CR-005/006/007 fixed as recommended, plus a partial-render credential defect the owner found independently. 50/50 tests green, mutation check confirmed.
